page.overview:
What is Blue Orb?

The Blue Orb is an item (Key item from Gen III-V) that controls Kyogre in the Hoenn region.

In Ruby, Sapphire and Emerald, the Blue Orb appears in Sapphire and controls Kyogre, which Maxie attempts to use to control Groudon, but fails.

In HeartGold and SoulSilver, it can also be obtained from Mr. Pokémon in both games and can be traded to its counterpart to receive the Jade Orb to awaken Rayquaza in the Embedded Tower.

In Omega Ruby and Alpha Sapphire, the Blue Orb becomes a standard item to accommodate the Primal Reversion of Kyogre.
